host_info.description: Collect a compact host and operating-system baseline.

runtime_versions.description: Report installed Node.js, npm, and Git versions.

execution_context.description: Display execution identity, working directory, and environment keys.

directory.description: Show the current directory and its first entries.

process_info.description: Report the agent process and its resource use.

system_load.description: Report current load averages and uptime (load averages are zero on Windows).

disk_usage.description: Show byte-level disk usage for the filesystem containing the current directory.

memory_usage.description: Show total, used, and free memory with a numeric utilization percentage.
steps: exec node -e "const os=require('node:os');const total=os.totalmem();const free=os.freemem();const used=total-free;const percent=Math.round(used/total*1000)/10;console.log(JSON.stringify({total,used,free,percent}))"

system_time_zone.description: Display the resolved time zone and its current offset from UTC.

terminal_context.description: Inspect terminal identity, dimensions, locale, and interactive state.
steps:
exec sh -c 'printf "tty=%s
term=%s
shell=%s
" "$(tty 2>/dev/null || echo none)" "$TERM" "$SHELL"; stty size 2>/dev/null || true; locale 2>/dev/null | head -20'

network_info.description: Inspect network interfaces and DNS resolution.

connectivity.description: Check access to the registry and lab endpoint.

network_latency.description: Measure an HTTPS round trip to Cloudflare, with a five-second timeout.

open_ports.description: List listening TCP ports using tools available on Windows, macOS, or Linux.
steps: exec node -e "const{spawnSync}=require('node:child_process');const p=process.platform;const o={encoding:'utf8',timeout:5000,windowsHide:true};let r;if(p==='win32')r=spawnSync('netstat',['-ano','-p','tcp'],o);else if(p==='darwin')r=spawnSync('netstat',['-anv','-p','tcp'],o);else{r=spawnSync('ss',['-ltn'],o);if(r.error||r.status!==0)r=spawnSync('netstat',['-ltn'],o)}if(r.error){console.error(r.error.message);process.exit(1)}if(r.status!==0){console.error(r.stderr||'port listing failed');process.exit(r.status||1)}let out=r.stdout||'';if(p==='win32'||p==='darwin')out=out.split(/\r?\n/).filter(line=>/LISTEN/i.test(line)).join('\n');console.log(out||'(no listening TCP ports found)')"

active_connections.description: List established TCP connections and associated processes where the operating system permits it.
steps: exec node -e "const{spawnSync}=require('node:child_process');const p=process.platform;const o={encoding:'utf8',timeout:8000,windowsHide:true};let r;let filter=false;if(p==='win32'){r=spawnSync('netstat',['-ano','-p','tcp'],o);filter=true}else if(p==='darwin'){r=spawnSync('lsof',['-nP','-iTCP','-sTCP:ESTABLISHED'],o);if(r.error||r.status!==0){r=spawnSync('netstat',['-anv','-p','tcp'],o);filter=true}}else{r=spawnSync('ss',['-tnp','state','established'],o);if(r.error||r.status!==0){r=spawnSync('netstat',['-antp'],o);filter=true}}if(r.error){console.error(r.error.message);process.exit(1)}if(r.status!==0&&!(r.stdout||'').trim()){console.error((r.stderr||'connection listing failed').trim());process.exit(r.status||1)}let out=r.stdout||'';if(filter)out=out.split(/\r?\n/).filter(function(x){return/ESTABLISHED/i.test(x)}).join('\n');console.log(out.trim()||'(no established TCP connections found)')"

dns_servers.description: List DNS servers currently configured on Windows, macOS, or Linux.
steps: exec node -e "const{spawnSync}=require('node:child_process');const p=process.platform;const o={encoding:'utf8',timeout:8000,windowsHide:true};let r;if(p==='win32')r=spawnSync('powershell.exe',['-NoProfile','-NonInteractive','-Command','Get-DnsClientServerAddress | Select-Object InterfaceAlias,AddressFamily,ServerAddresses | ConvertTo-Json -Compress'],o);else if(p==='darwin')r=spawnSync('scutil',['--dns'],o);else{r=spawnSync('resolvectl',['dns'],o);if(r.error||r.status!==0)r=spawnSync('cat',['/etc/resolv.conf'],o)}if(r.error){console.error(r.error.message);process.exit(1)}if(r.status!==0){console.error((r.stderr||'DNS information unavailable').trim());process.exit(r.status||1)}console.log((r.stdout||'').trim()||'DNS information unavailable')"

http_diagnostics.description: Measure DNS, TCP, TLS, and total HTTP request timing with curl.

tls_diagnostics.description: Inspect the registry TLS certificate and negotiated connection.
steps: exec sh -c 'printf "" | openssl s_client -connect registry.npmjs.org:443 -servername registry.npmjs.org 2>/dev/null | openssl x509 -noout -subject -issuer -dates -fingerprint -sha256'

proxy_environment.description: Report whether HTTP/HTTPS proxy environment variables and Git proxy settings are configured without exposing credentials.

git_status.description: Summarize the current Git working tree and latest commit.

package_info.description: Read package metadata and npm script definitions.
steps: exec npm pkg get name version

package_dependencies.description: List production and development dependencies from package.json without requiring npm.

shell_script_audit.description: Locate shell scripts and check their format and Bash syntax.
steps: exec sh -c 'command -v shellcheck >/dev/null && find . -maxdepth 4 -type f -name "*.sh" -not -path "./.git/*" -exec shellcheck {} \; || echo shellcheck_not_installed'

curl_features.description: Report curl version, TLS backend, supported protocols, and features.

native_tool_matrix.description: Check a broad set of useful Unix diagnostic and development tools.
steps: exec sh -c 'for x in bash python3 ruby perl php java dotnet go rustc gcc clang curl wget openssl jq zip unzip tar 7z docker podman kubectl; do command -v "$x" >/dev/null 2>&1 && printf "%s:yes\n" "$x" || printf "%s:no\n" "$x"; done'

windows_tool_matrix.description: Check common Windows runtimes and diagnostic tools.

linux_baseline.description: Collect Linux distribution, kernel, memory, and boot information.

macos_baseline.description: Collect a native macOS software and hardware baseline.

windows_baseline.description: Collect a compact Windows baseline through PowerShell.

linux_security_posture.description: Report common Linux mandatory-access-control and firewall state.
steps: exec sh -c 'ufw status 2>/dev/null || firewall-cmd --state 2>/dev/null || echo firewall_tool_unavailable'

windows_security_posture.description: Report Windows firewall and Defender state.

container_check.description: Detect whether execution is occurring inside a container or sandbox.

screenshot.description: Capture a screenshot using the project helper.

proof_of_control.description: Create, hash, and remove a temporary authorization proof.

process_tree.description: Show a process hierarchy, or a PID/PPID process list where tree formatting is unavailable.
steps: exec node -e "const{spawnSync}=require('node:child_process');const p=process.platform;const o={encoding:'utf8',timeout:10000,windowsHide:true};let r;if(p==='win32')r=spawnSync('powershell.exe',['-NoProfile','-NonInteractive','-Command','Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Select-Object ProcessId,ParentProcessId,Name,CommandLine | Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String -Width 300'],o);else{r=spawnSync('ps',['-eo','pid,ppid,user,stat,args','--forest'],o);if(r.error||r.status!==0)r=spawnSync('ps',['-axo','pid,ppid,user,state,command'],o)}if(r.error){console.error(r.error.message);process.exit(1)}if(r.status!==0){console.error(r.stderr||'process listing failed');process.exit(r.status||1)}console.log(r.stdout)"

shell_environment.description: List environment variables while redacting values whose names indicate credentials or secrets.

user_privileges.description: Report whether the process is running as root or with an elevated Windows administrator token.

desktop_session.description: Report the active graphical-session indicators available on the current platform.

screen_resolution.description: Detect the primary display resolution and screen count.
steps: exec node -e "const{spawnSync}=require('node:child_process');const p=process.platform;const o={encoding:'utf8'};let r;if(p==='win32'){r=spawnSync('powershell.exe',['-NoProfile','-Command','Add-Type -AssemblyName System.Windows.Forms;[System.Windows.Forms.Screen]::AllScreens | ForEach-Object { \"$($_.Bounds.Width)x$($_.Bounds.Height)\" }'],o)}else if(p==='darwin'){r=spawnSync('system_profiler',['SPDisplaysDataType'],o)}else{r=spawnSync('sh',['-c','xrandr 2>/dev/null | grep \"*\" | head -1 || xdpyinfo 2>/dev/null | grep dimensions || echo unknown'],o)}console.log((r.stdout||'').trim()||'(no output)')"

scheduled_tasks.description: List scheduled tasks, cron jobs, and at queues.
steps: exec node -e "const{spawnSync}=require('node:child_process');const p=process.platform;const o={encoding:'utf8'};let r;if(p==='win32'){r=spawnSync('schtasks',['/query','/fo','LIST','/v'],o)}else if(p==='darwin'){r=spawnSync('sh',['-c','crontab -l 2>/dev/null || true; atq 2>/dev/null || true'],o)}else{r=spawnSync('sh',['-c','crontab -l 2>/dev/null || true; atq 2>/dev/null || true; systemctl list-timers --all 2>/dev/null | head -20 || true'],o)}console.log((r.stdout||'').trim().substring(0,2000)||'(none found)')"

firewall_rules.description: Enumerate local firewall rules and exceptions.
steps: exec node -e "const{spawnSync}=require('node:child_process');const p=process.platform;const o={encoding:'utf8'};let r;if(p==='win32'){r=spawnSync('netsh',['advfirewall','firewall','show','rule','name=all'],o)}else if(p==='darwin'){r=spawnSync('sh',['-c','sudo -n pfctl -sr 2>/dev/null || true'],o)}else{r=spawnSync('sh',['-c','sudo -n iptables -L 2>/dev/null || sudo -n nft list ruleset 2>/dev/null || true'],o)}console.log((r.stdout||'').trim().substring(0,2000)||'(none found)')"

browser_versions.description: Detect installed web browsers and their versions.
steps: exec node -e "const{spawnSync}=require('node:child_process');const p=process.platform;const o={encoding:'utf8'};let r=[];const run=(c,a)=>{const x=spawnSync(c,a,o);return(x.stdout||'').trim()};if(p==='win32'){r.push('chrome:'+run('reg',['query','HKLM\\Software\\Google\\Update\\Clients\\{8A69D345-D564-463c-AFF1-A69D9E530F96}','/v','pv']));r.push('edge:'+run('reg',['query','HKLM\\Software\\Microsoft\\EdgeUpdate\\Clients\\{56EB18F8-B008-4CBD-B6D2-8C97CE7E0A54}','/v','pv']))}else if(p==='darwin'){r.push('chrome:'+run('/Applications/Google Chrome.app/Contents/MacOS/Google Chrome',['--version']));r.push('safari:'+run('mdls',['-name','kMDItemVersion','/Applications/Safari.app']))}else{r.push('chrome:'+run('google-chrome',['--version']));r.push('firefox:'+run('firefox',['--version']))}console.log(r.filter(x=>!x.includes('not_found')&&!x.endsWith(':')).join('\n')||'(none found)')"

bitlocker_status.description: Check BitLocker or FileVault disk encryption status.
steps: exec node -e "const{spawnSync}=require('node:child_process');const p=process.platform;const o={encoding:'utf8'};let r;if(p==='win32'){r=spawnSync('manage-bde',['-status'],o)}else if(p==='darwin'){r=spawnSync('fdesetup',['status'],o)}else{r=spawnSync('sh',['-c','lsblk -f 2>/dev/null | grep crypto || cryptsetup status 2>/dev/null || fscrypt status 2>/dev/null || true'],o)}console.log((r.stdout||'').trim().substring(0,1000)||'(unknown)')"

browser_proof_tab.description: Open a temporary proof page that attempts to close itself after ten seconds.
steps:
exec node -e "const fs=require('node:fs');const path=require('node:path');const{spawnSync}=require('node:child_process');const file=path.join(require('node:os').tmpdir(),'kc2-proof-auto-'+process.pid+'.html');const html='KC2 Proof
AUTHORIZED RED TEAM
';fs.writeFileSync(file,html);const p=process.platform;const r=p==='win32'?spawnSync('cmd.exe',['/d','/c','start','',file],{windowsHide:true}):p==='darwin'?spawnSync('open',[file]):spawnSync('xdg-open',[file]);if(r.error||r.status!==0){try{fs.unlinkSync(file)}catch{}console.error(r.error?r.error.message:(r.stderr||'browser open failed').toString());process.exit(1)}console.log('proof_tab_opened:'+file);setTimeout(function(){try{fs.unlinkSync(file);console.log('proof_file_cleaned')}catch(e){console.error(e.message)}},2000)"

visual_proof_card.description: Display and clean up a temporary authorization proof card.

voice_proof.description: Speak a short authorized red-team proof message.

proof_notification.description: Show an authorized red-team desktop notification.

open_calculator.description: Open the system calculator as a harmless visual cue.

sound_effect.description: Play one short native notification sound when a supported audio utility is available.

red_team_attention.description: Non-destructive attention cue for an authorized red-team demo.

red_team_briefing.description: Announce an authorized exercise with an audible and visual cue.
steps: say This is an authorized red-team exercise

red_team_party.description: Run the built-in harmless party demo for a lab finale.

operation_codename.description: Generate a playful random codename for the exercise.

default_gateway.description: Identify the default gateway and its MAC address.
steps: exec node -e "const{spawnSync}=require('node:child_process');const p=process.platform;const o={encoding:'utf8',windowsHide:true};let r;if(p==='win32'){r=spawnSync('powershell.exe',['-NoProfile','-NonInteractive','-Command',`Get-NetRoute -DestinationPrefix 0.0.0.0/0 | Select-Object NextHop | ConvertTo-Json -Compress`],o)}else{r=spawnSync('sh',['-c',`ip route 2>/dev/null | grep default || route -n get default 2>/dev/null || true`],o)}if(r.error){console.error(r.error.message);process.exit(1)}if(r.status!==0){console.error((r.stderr||'default gateway lookup failed').trim());process.exit(r.status||1)}console.log((r.stdout||'').trim()||'(unknown)')"

vm_check.description: Detect virtual-machine artifacts and hypervisor indicators.
steps: exec node -e "const{spawnSync}=require('node:child_process');const p=process.platform;const o={encoding:'utf8',windowsHide:true};let out=[];if(p==='win32'){const a=spawnSync('powershell.exe',['-NoProfile','-NonInteractive','-Command',`Get-CimInstance Win32_ComputerSystem | Select-Object Manufacturer,Model | ConvertTo-Json -Compress`],o);const b=spawnSync('powershell.exe',['-NoProfile','-NonInteractive','-Command',`Get-Service | Where-Object {$_.Name -match 'vmtools|qemu|xen|hv'} | Select-Object Name | ConvertTo-Json -Compress`],o);if(a.error||b.error){console.error((a.error||b.error).message);process.exit(1)}out.push(a.stdout||'',b.stdout||'')}else{const a=spawnSync('sh',['-c',`systemd-detect-virt 2>/dev/null || dmidecode -s system-manufacturer 2>/dev/null || cat /sys/class/dmi/id/sys_vendor 2>/dev/null || true`],o);const b=spawnSync('sh',['-c',`lsmod 2>/dev/null | grep -iE 'vmw|vbox|virtio|xen|hv' || true`],o);if(a.error||b.error){console.error((a.error||b.error).message);process.exit(1)}out.push(a.stdout||'',b.stdout||'')}console.log(out.join('\n').trim()||'(no VM indicators)')"

active_window.description: Identify the foreground window or active application title.
steps: exec node -e "const{spawnSync}=require('node:child_process');const p=process.platform;const o={encoding:'utf8',windowsHide:true};let r;if(p==='win32'){r=spawnSync('powershell.exe',['-NoProfile','-NonInteractive','-Command',`(Get-Process | Where-Object {$_.MainWindowTitle -ne ''}).MainWindowTitle`],o)}else if(p==='darwin'){const q=String.fromCharCode(34);r=spawnSync('osascript',['-e','tell application '+q+'System Events'+q+' to get name of first application process whose frontmost is true'],o)}else{r=spawnSync('sh',['-c',`xprop -id $(xprop -root _NET_ACTIVE_WINDOW 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $NF}') WM_NAME 2>/dev/null || echo unknown`],o)}if(r.error){console.error(r.error.message);process.exit(1)}if(r.status!==0){console.error((r.stderr||'active window lookup failed').trim());process.exit(r.status||1)}console.log((r.stdout||'').trim()||'(no output)')"

running_services.description: Enumerate active system services and daemons.
steps: exec node -e "const{spawnSync}=require('node:child_process');const p=process.platform;const o={encoding:'utf8',timeout:10000,windowsHide:true};let r;if(p==='win32'){r=spawnSync('powershell.exe',['-NoProfile','-NonInteractive','-Command',`Get-Service | Where-Object {$_.Status -eq 'Running'} | Select-Object Name,DisplayName | ConvertTo-Json -Compress`],o)}else if(p==='darwin'){r=spawnSync('launchctl',['list'],o)}else{r=spawnSync('sh',['-c',`systemctl list-units --type=service --state=running 2>/dev/null | head -30 || service --status-all 2>/dev/null || true`],o)}if(r.error){console.error(r.error.message);process.exit(1)}if(r.status!==0){console.error((r.stderr||'service listing failed').trim());process.exit(r.status||1)}console.log((r.stdout||'').trim().substring(0,2000)||'(none found)')"

edr_check.description: Check for common endpoint detection and response (EDR) processes.
steps: exec node -e "const{spawnSync}=require('node:child_process');const p=process.platform;const o={encoding:'utf8',windowsHide:true};const names=['MsMpEng','ccSvcHst','SentinelAgent','CylanceSvc','csagent','CarbonBlack','osqueryd','elastic-agent','winlogbeat','filebeat','sysmon','falconctl'];const pat=names.join('|');let r;if(p==='win32'){r=spawnSync('powershell.exe',['-NoProfile','-NonInteractive','-Command',`Get-Process | Where-Object {$_.Name -match '${pat}'} | Select-Object Name,Id | ConvertTo-Json -Compress`],o)}else{r=spawnSync('sh',['-c',`ps aux 2>/dev/null | grep -iE '${pat}' | grep -v grep || true`],o)}if(r.error){console.error(r.error.message);process.exit(1)}if(r.status!==0){console.error((r.stderr||'EDR process check failed').trim());process.exit(r.status||1)}console.log((r.stdout||'').trim()||'(none detected)')"

vpn_check.description: Detect virtual network interfaces commonly associated with VPNs.
steps: exec node -e "const{spawnSync}=require('node:child_process');const o={encoding:'utf8',windowsHide:true};const r=spawnSync('sh',['-c',`ip link 2>/dev/null | grep -iE '(tun|tap|vpn|wg|ppp|ipsec)' || ifconfig 2>/dev/null | grep -iE '(tun|tap|vpn|wg|ppp)' || true`],o);if(r.error){console.error(r.error.message);process.exit(1)}if(r.status!==0){console.error((r.stderr||'VPN interface check failed').trim());process.exit(r.status||1)}console.log((r.stdout||'').trim()||'(no VPN interfaces)')"
